nom: Exuviance Deep Clean AHA Face Cleanser + Makeup Remover

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily/combination skin generally describe the cleanser as effective at deep-cleaning and reducing shine and pores without over-drying, though one oily-skin user found it slightly drying when used twice daily.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several say it cleans without stripping or drying their skin, while others with dry or combination-dry skin report it left their face very dry, flaky, or with a burning red ring.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers mostly report gentle, non-stripping cleansing with improved texture and reduced breakouts, though one combination/oily reviewer found it drying with a rough after-feel.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: some (including one with rosacea) call it a calming, non-irritating staple, while others warn it is not for sensitive skin due to dryness, burning, or eye irritation.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing normal or normal-to-oily skin say it is gentle, effective, and does not leave skin feeling stripped.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers in their 40s-70s report smoother, softer, brighter-looking skin and softer-looking wrinkles with regular use.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report smoother texture, brighter skin, and softer-looking wrinkles with continued use; no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers say the cleanser does not strip or dry their skin, but a notable minority (including dry, sensitive, and combination/oily skin) report significant dryness, flaking, tightness, or a burning red ring after use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea says it calms her skin, while another reports the product left her face burning with visible redness around the face and eyes.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers feel clean without a stripped or tight after-feel, though some AHA-sensitive users recommend easing in gradually (e.g., once weekly) to avoid over-drying and compromised comfort.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report clearer, faster-resolving blackheads and reduced dark spots or hyperpigmentation within days to weeks; no negative reports on this specific concern.
concerns.blemishes: Numerous reviewers, including several with hormonal, cystic, or PCOS-related acne, report significantly fewer breakouts and faster clearing, sometimes within days; one reviewer noted a spot felt like it was becoming a pimple after use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers generally report the product controls surface oil and shine effectively without over-drying, though one noted it was slightly drying even on oily skin when used daily.

aspects.libelle: Product economy, lasts a long time
High price point relative to size

extraits.texte: I was originally using Fresh soy cleaners and j wanted to try something new. An Ulta employee recommended me this plus the toner… I regret buying it. My face feels EXTREMELY dry after use. It was so bad it dried my skin out. My skin started flakey and it was burning. I thought maybe bc it was new my skin was purging but nope. Dried out my forehead and temple now there's a red ring around my face and it dried out my eyes and under eyes and my chin. Definitely not for sensitive skin! I wish I can post my face so y'all can see how red it is!

I have tried literally EVERYTHING to get rid of my hormonal/pcos acne, I've struggled with it for about NINE YEARS! This is probably the only skincare product I have used that has given me practically instant results, without the purging. I was recommended this cleanser by an ulta employee and I'm truly so happy they pointed me to this product. I tend to get lots of neck and cheek pimples accompanied by PIE and other texture from scarring. This cleanser has SIGNIFICANTLY lessened my breakouts, acne scars and any other skin tone unevenness. (WITHIN EVEN THE FIRST COUPLE DAYS OF USE). Do not be scared by the price, this cleanser should last you a while, plus this stuff works so it's not a waste. Please don't wait any longer! Save your skin and get this stuff! 1000000000/10. I'll be going back to ulta to purchase more from this line FOR SURE!
I have sensitive skin with rosacea and this has been a staple for years. I rarely review but I would highly recommend this product. It does the job and does so while calming the skin.

I have been struggling with milia for basically forever. I have very sysitive skin too. i could never find a face wash that truely removed the sticky oils, flacky skin and clear my pores. most of the products i tried would strip the top layer of EVERYTHING, making my skin so dry and tight while leaving the deep seeded (open) pores untouched. It was to the point i was afraid to use SPF because i knew it would basically never leave my face. After using this just one time my little open pores on my cheek where so clean they where lines instead of Os.

I have used this cleanser for years. Every time I try something else, I'm running back to Exuviance. It's gentle & prevents breakouts & keeps my skin moisturized at the same time. I have very sensitive, dry skin.

I bought this face wash a few years ago for an early Black Friday deal. I was highly impressed after the first use. I am over 40 with mature combination skin. The love the scent it's fresh and not overwhelming. I have noticed wrinkles appear to me softer and less noticeable. Major improvement in my skin texture. All in all this is such a wonderful face wash. It gives a good lather, rinses off, and face feel baby smooth after every use. I use at least once daily sometimes twice. I have repurchased several times and it's a huge bonus when it's on sale.

I love Exuviance but they are speedy and their bottles are unbelievably small, this bottle is huge though! Very pleased with the size as well as the efficacy of the cleanser. It really helped eliminate tenacious blackheads around my nose, and you really don't need much product to wash your whole face. I'm pleased with how quickly it helped get rid of my blackhead. I found it to be slightly drying even on my oily skin, so I only use it once a day.
